test.query: SELECT sum(NOT ignore(*)) FROM (SELECT * FROM generateRandom('x JSON', 0, 10, 10) LIMIT 10000000);
SELECT sum(NOT ignore(*)) FROM (SELECT * FROM generateRandom('x JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 4)', 0, 10, 10) LIMIT 3000000);
SELECT sum(NOT ignore(*)) FROM (SELECT * FROM generateRandom('x Dynamic', 1, 10, 10) LIMIT 300000000);
SELECT sum(NOT ignore(*)) FROM (SELECT * FROM generateRandom('x Variant(UInt64, String, Array(UInt8))', 0, 10, 10) LIMIT 300000000);

SELECT sum(NOT ignore(*)) FROM (SELECT * FROM generateRandom('x Tuple(a String, b String, c Int64, d Int64, e UInt64, f Float64, g Float64, h Bool, i Nullable(String), j Array(Nullable(Int64)), k Tuple(String, Int64, Float64), l Date)', 0, 10, 10) LIMIT 10000000);
